name: governance-kit-docs
description: Static documentation site for governance-kit. Mintlify-format docs.json + MDX, rendered by a custom generator (scripts/docs-site/) and deployed to GitHub Pages.

scripts.docs:build: node scripts/docs-site/gen-reference.mjs && node scripts/docs-site/build.mjs && node scripts/docs-site/source-index.mjs && pagefind --site dist/docs-site --output-path dist/docs-site/pagefind && node scripts/docs-site/pagefind-normalize.mjs
